⚡ 30-Second Chrome Installation
  1. Download and unzip acadmail-ai.zip.
  2. In Chrome, open chrome://extensions and toggle Developer Mode on (top-right).
  3. Click Load unpacked and select the unzipped folder. Refresh Gmail and enjoy!
